notes.title: 🛠️ UPDATE 1.3.1.0 - SANDBOX STAGES
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we have some nice new features for Common’hood; New Stages for the Multiplayer and Sandbox modes of the game. Now you can finally play creative mode in any of the areas of the factory; West wing, Pumping Grounds, Machine Room, Factory Entrance, Green House, Barren Lands and the Shipyard. You can build creations in these locations with your friends in multiplayer. We have also continued fixing bugs based on the feedback we have received. See below the update notes, we hope you enjoy the update.

🌱- New Sandbox and Multiplayer stages
🌱- Hold to pack feature (pack any machine, blueprint, or custom object)
🌱- Quick swap between UI/inventory panels on the controller (d-pad)
🌱- Inventory overflow (receiving items with a full inventory) now spawns boxes with the items
🌱- Split the look sensitivity slider into X and Y components
🌱- Blueprint breakdown now works on the controller as well (hold X and then L trigger)

⚖️- Lost in-world key items now respawn if not detected in player inventories 
⚖️- Solar panels no longer depend on light levels. They now work like a consistent generator without the fuel costs


🐞- Fixed save panel input field not working
🐞- Crops now save their growth in other regions properly
🐞- Added additional safeguards for saving key items
🐞- Fixed settings dropdowns to display appropriate selections
🐞- The research panel now displays unlocked tech regardless of the tech level of the bench used
🐞- Blueprint aux panel steps list now scrolls on the controller

notes.title: Devblog AMA
notes.notes:
Common’hood is now two months old and we couldn’t be more grateful for your support. Thank you for continuing to engage with us closely on our community platforms and being patient with us! 🎉 

Although we have been working hard to actively fix recurring bugs and common issues, we know there have been hiccups along the way. In our efforts to provide quick solutions, we have released nine patches to date. We know that sometimes these patches are capable of introducing new issues. Going forward, we want to be more mindful of thorough testing before releasing new patches.

📢  We are currently working on a big engine update and we want to hear how we can improve your gameplay experience. We are holding an #AMA session live on our Discord server on 14 January 2023, Saturday at 1 pm ET/10 am PST.  You can join the conversation with our Director, Jose Sanchez on upcoming updates, challenges faced, and future plans for Common’hood.

Please leave any burning questions, comments, and feedback you have for us on our community forums (Discord, Reddit, and Steam). We will do our best to answer all your queries. This is your time to be heard! 

As always, we feel incredibly lucky to have a loyal and engaging community like you all. Thank you for being on this journey with us. We hope to continue to make Common’hood a fun experience for you! 🌱 💖

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
After years of work, the time has come; Common’hood has a release date!

[previewyoutube=j8kIFsMWQNY;full]https://youtu.be/j8kIFsMWQNY[/previewyoutube]

Come November 10th, you’ll be able to dive into our community building and economy management game and get your hands on Common’hood’s unique set of customizable base building tools. 

Our story mode is complete, presenting with an emotional, challenging journey alongside Nikki to unravel the mystery of the abandoned factory. The full release will also come alongside a creative multiplayer mode for you to cooperatively build with your friends, come up with new designs and express yourselves freely.

We want to thank our community, as this has only been made possible through your support and assistance, from the simple act of wishlisting our game to those brave few who helped us test the game and deal with bugs, balancing and general feedback.

The Plethora Project team hopes you’ll love the game as much as we’ve loved making it. See you on November 10th on Steam!

notes.title: New details about the upcoming multiplayer update!
notes.notes:
Hello Common’hood Community!

We know it’s been a while since our last update, but we want to assure everyone that development has been healthy and active. We would like to thank our testing team on [url=https://discord.gg/MJc3gmf]Discord[/url] for working extremely hard to ensure all players have the best experience possible when playing Common’hood. We love seeing the thriving communities that those who have already jumped into the game have built. Those of you who are still waiting patiently, we can’t wait to see your amazing creations.

As you may have read, we have been able to upgrade our capabilities, allowing us to welcome a professional QA team to our workflow. Together, we have been able to work on and fix a ton of small polish issues with the game. Delivering the best version of Common’hood to players has always been our number one priority and we hope that everyone is impressed with these changes and updates.

We are excited about the upcoming multiplayer update and wanted to give players more of an idea of what they can expect when they head into the game with their friends later this year.  The first version of multiplayer that will be available to try will be an extension of our sandbox environment. It will give players the chance to build and design with their friends. No limit on materials gives players infinite possibilities. Once you’re done designing you can save your project and share it with either the Common’hood community online or in your single-player story mode.

We appreciate the support from all of those who have been keeping up with us in [url=https://discord.gg/MJc3gmf]Discord[/url], wishlisting the game, testing out the updates, and giving us valuable feedback. It is because of you that we are able to do this and bring Common’hood to life. Look out for even more updates coming soon!

notes.title: Polish, Polish, Polish!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BqvPt1U.jpg[/img]

The Common’hood team is back to give you an update on development and our upcoming release. Our full-time work on the game has continued since our last message and we’re happy to say Common’hood is really close to release.

The last few months have been dedicated to polish as well as building our sandbox multiplayer mode. In the Multiplayer Sandbox you will be able to play alongside your friends, design and build to your collective creativity’s desire with unlimited materials. This mode is not only great for creative expression, but it’ll allow you to create blueprints to share with other players or use in the Story mode.

Common’hood has grown to become a larger game than what we anticipated, which has us excited but at the same time there has been a lot of polish necessary for reaching the standard that we think you deserve. So, we are not there yet, but we are getting closer. 

This are the mayor updates that we have finished recently:

[list]
[*] Completion of the campaign
[*] Online Multiplayer Sandbox
[*] Upgraded character models
[*] Upgrades to NPCs AI.
[*] Upgrades to Pathfining.
[*] Final OST

[/list]

We are currently working with our QA partners to polish all the hundreds of details that are necessary to reach a finished product. We want to reassure you that we are working hard on having the game ready as soon as possible and we will be announcing our release date as soon as we feel that we have a finished product.

We are planning to do some network testing in the coming weeks so please join us in our [url=https://discord.gg/Bud8bv36hw]Discord[/url] if you would like to take part.

notes.title: On our planned release date
notes.notes:
After months and months of development, beta testing and the demo release, we’ve been nothing short of thrilled by your enthusiastic response.  However, we’ve also realized that if we were to stick to our original release date of Fall 2021, Common’hood would not be the game we envision, and most importantly, the one you deserve.

Due to the mixture between simulation and narrative, we are not aiming to do an early access release, as we don’t want to spoil the story of the game as we gradually iterate over it’s implementation. We want to release a finished product.

At the current rate of development, the version of Common’hood that would come out on this date wouldn’t have the level of polish we find acceptable. This would leave us with the choice of either narrowing the scope of the final version or releasing a less optimized version of the game to patch and fix at a later date.

Therefore we are officially announcing that we’re aiming to have Common’hood out and in your hands on March 2022. We know waiting isn’t the greatest feeling, but we hope that the wait will be very much worth it. Common’hood has ended up being a much larger project than originally intended (which we are very excited about) and that has required a lot more balancing and polishing time.

We appreciate the support from all of those who have wishlisted the game, those who have kept up with  our progress and to the people in our [url=https://discord.gg/MJc3gmf]Discord[/url] handing out valuable feedback and participating in our playtests. We hope you will stick with us til the end!

-The Common’hood Dev Team

notes.title: Common'hood Closed Beta Two - Freeform - is now On!
notes.notes:
The wait is over, time for the next Beta phase! We heard your feedback loud and clear, and besides stomping down on the bugs you helped us find, we’ve focused our work on improving the game’s construction systems. Thus we’ve implemented:


[list]
[*] Upgraded building system: More responsive, cleaner and stuffed full of new possibilities
[*] Online blueprint sharing: Use the in-game database and share your creations with other players - We will be selecting from this to create the default database for every player at launch!
[*] Custom blueprint creation: We’re really dedicated to tearing down all creativity barriers!
[*] New Materials & ways to build: Let your imagination be the limit, not the tools in your hands!
[*] Infinite Sandbox Stockpile: It’s bigger on the inside. Not available in story mode.
[*] Automation system: Free your settlers, let robots do the hard, repetitive work!
[*] Bug-fixes and changes galore: Made possible thanks to the feedback you gave us!
[/list]

Help us test them out! What kind of awesome buildings and furniture will you make and share in our online blueprint system? Which materials will you choose? Have we made the building process intuitive and smooth enough? 

All of this will be answered on Beta 2! Wanna sign up? Get a steam key by following the steps below:

1 -  join our Discord at:
https://discord.gg/SrCPgQz

2 - Once you’re in there, hop into any of the public channels and type out:
“i want to test” 
(in any channel)

notes.notes:
We need your help testing Common’hood so that together, we can make it the best game it can be! 

The game's development has moved forward and thus we're finally ready! Common’hood will now undergo a series of Closed Beta events, allowing us to gather feedback and polish the game. This will give us the chance to improve key areas of the game based on your comments, eventually leading to the best possible 1.0 for all of us.

[b]On April 19th we’ll open up Beta One - Building the Basics.[/b]The base systems of the game are now implemented, and we need your help to test their limits and of course, shower us in feedback for what the game could do better, or what you’d like to see in it! We’ll be closing Beta One on May 10th.

Please remember that what you’re seeing is the first of several closed betas on the way to our Fall 2021 release, so what you see in Closed Beta One is not an accurate reflection of what 1.0 will look like.

notes.title: New Trailer Out! Thank you for letting us grow our project
notes.notes:
We are proud to present our new trailer for Common’hood, showcasing the growth of the game’s scope and features since our original inception. May this personal story we're trying to tell resonate with you! Share it with your friends if you think they'll like it and wishlist us on Steam!

[previewyoutube=8GYyG0FP-BU;full][/previewyoutube]

Common’hood is a community building and economy management game with highly customizable base building tools. The game is set against the backdrop of an economic crash where the player is tasked with building a post-capitalist society. The player is challenged to go beyond survival and develop a thriving community with the odds stacked against them.

notes.notes:
We've been firing at all cinders over here at Plethora, broadening both the scope and upping the quality of the game we're building for you in Common'Hood and we're just about ready to show you where the game's headed and what we have achieved so far.

We're eager to get the updated version of the game into your hands, and hope you will enjoy the improvements we've been working hard on. Keep your eyes on this space to be the first to see the new trailer showcasing the growth of the game very soon!

We thank all our supporters for keeping your attention on the game, we're working to build something that you will love, and maybe even move you.

-Your friends at Plethora Project

notes.title: Active Development and Demo News
notes.notes:
After working on Common'hood for a while, we have secured funding and thus the game has entered Active Development. Usually this sort of thing would mean everyone showing up at a place and sharing drinks to celebrate, but you ever try to set up a gamedev studio during a global pandemic? It’s hard.

Everyone at Plethora is pumped to get Common’hood into your hands to let you experience Nikki’s story and build a thriving community of your own, we can't wait!

Speaking of the game, we no longer feel that the Demo properly showcases what the game will eventually look and work like, therefore we're disabling it to prevent you from getting the wrong impression of it. Worry not, we're doubling down on updates and sharing progress from the team so you know what we're building.

Stay tuned, we're going places.

The sandbox demo is finally out!! 

The demo can be accessed via our discord channel:
https://discord.gg/BTSzvZz

A few things to note:
- The sandbox will be available once you complete the story. That is - if you have a save where you repaired the crane and built the bridge, it will automatically and retroactively be unlocked.
- Two big new features we've been working on are also playable: tech tree and blueprint viewer. We hope the game itself will do a good job walking you through it :)
- There's a new way to plant! I want to mention this here since it's not in the tutorials yet. If you equip seeds/water you can plant or water planters by simply clicking on them.
- We've also included fixes to a bunch of the bugs reported a few weeks ago. Planter bugs, stuck in chair bugs, etc.
- We've activated our subreddit as an alternative for bug reporting now, so feel free to use it if that's your thing: 
https://www.reddit.com/r/commonhood/comments/f2e33i/official_bug_reports_thread/
I personally feel that a reddit thread is easier for archiving.

Happy testing! 
All feedbacks are appreciated
